discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_17/section_17.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_17/section_17.2/cis_17.2.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Applies to: Domain Controller only (from the upstream task name).

No runnable check (the role applies it, but no check could be translated); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "17.2.2 | PATCH | Ensure Audit Computer Account Management is set to include Success DC only | Domain Controller"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_17_2_2
    - prelim_win22cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - rule_17.2.2
    - patch
    - NIST800-171_3.3.1
    - NIST800-171_3.3.2
    - NIST800-171_3.3.6
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-3
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-3_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-7
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-12
  block:
    - name: "17.2.2 | AUDIT | Ensure Audit Computer Account Management is set to include Success DC only | Get current audit events for Computer Account Management | Domain Controller"
      ansible.windows.win_shell: AuditPol /get /subcategory:"{0cce9236-69ae-11d9-bed3-505054503030}" -r | ConvertFrom-Csv | Select-Object -expand "Inclusion Setting"
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      check_mode: false
      register: discovered_17_2_2_audit

    - name: "17.2.2 | PATCH | Ensure Audit Computer Account Management is set to include Success DC only | Enable Success for Computer Account Management | Domain Controller"
      when: "'Success' not in discovered_17_2_2_audit.stdout"
      ansible.windows.win_shell: AuditPol /set /subcategory:"{0cce9236-69ae-11d9-bed3-505054503030}" /success:enable
